## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes for a user and why.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Distinguish foundation tests,
application tests, ATT&CK coverage checks, and real detection-runtime validation.
For UI changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots and keyboard-check results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Existing CLI/UI behavior is preserved, or an intentional change is documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and reproduce any fixed regression.
- [ ] ATT&CK version, sources, and prompt/procedure coverage are unchanged or explained.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, build output, or unnecessary archives are included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect the change.
- [ ] Generated detections have accurate validation status and limitations.
- [ ] Licensing and attribution requirements have been preserved.

## Known limitations

Record anything not tested and why. A checked box must describe evidence, not an assumption.
